lint.description: Check formatting with Prettier. Non-blocking: CRLF checkouts on Windows can still fail this in the Linux container (run `npm run format` from the workspace root when it does).

test.description: Run the automated test suite (npm test --workspaces). Linux-native node_modules come from deps-install/deps-reinstall in-container (specs/015 US2). Non-blocking for now: the container suite currently crashes at vitest worker teardown (node RemoveEnvironmentCleanupHook assert with native addons — tracked DEPLOY-015c); the WSL host suite is the authoritative signal until then.

deps-install.description: Install Node dependencies: npm ci clean semantics with fallback to npm install when no lockfile exists (the result's via label records which strategy ran — audit note). riskClass workspace_write (FR-053 approval), exposure-filtered output (specs/015 FR-1211).

deps-reinstall.description: Clean Node dependencies: delete node_modules (lockfile preserved), then reinstall — workspace-scoped (runs in the workspace root, no path traversal). For native-addon ABI mismatches (ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED): reinstall INSIDE the container for a Linux-native tree. riskClass workspace_write (FR-053 approval), exposure-filtered output (specs/015 FR-1212).

docs-drift.description: Documentation-Drift-Gate (specs/010, FR-951/952): read-only deterministic checks — README tool table vs. tool-name sources, assistant question catalog, ERROR_CODES table coverage, spec status hygiene. Fails closed on missing README; exit 1 on any finding.

final-review-gate.description: Final-Review Evidence Gate (amendment 003, FR-120/121): validates .guidance/state/final-review.json — strict schema, headCommit == HEAD (any commit after the review invalidates the gate), no open HIGH/CRITICAL findings.

index-freshness.description: Verify the GitNexus index is FRESH: .gitnexus/meta.json (lastCommit + branch) must match git HEAD. Deterministic freshness check (GUID-6) — the git state is resolved by reading .git files, no git binary required. Refresh host-side via gitnexus analyze --no-stats.

gitnexus-check.description: Risk-class assignment for the gitnexus `check` tool (WC-1-B): wildcard server + no operations entry would fail authorization_required; this read-only entry assigns the risk class so composite gates (repository-analysis) and run_operation can invoke it.

repository-analysis.description: Verify the GitNexus index for this repo is present and queryable (HTTP mode: mcpTool check; stdio mode: local CLI refresh via analyze --no-stats). The index REFRESH itself stays a host-side pre-complete step (AGENTS.md): the HTTP server exposes no analyze tool.

reasoning-pass.description: Orchestrated Clear-Thought sequential_thinking pass (timeout-resilient route: guidance ClientManager with reconnect instead of the editor's direct MCP connection). Used for the workflow-mandated reasoning minimum (AGENTS.md); ad-hoc reasoning stays on the editor tools.

capture-session-lessons.description: Seed validated session lessons (see .github/prompts/capture-lessons.prompt.md pattern). The agent writes .guidance/state/session-lessons.json BEFORE calling complete_workflow (empty array = no-op success; redact secrets). Idempotent per slug.
